risk_register.label: Data quality risk
risk_register.trigger_reason: data_foundations final_score=6.94 vs thresholds HIGH<4.0 MEDIUM<6.0
risk_register.mitigation: Aspiga should implement data validation checks on the Shopify platform to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK GDPR Article 5(1)(d) — data accuracy principle
fashion_extensions_applied: Size and measurement data inconsistency across product lines prevents sizing AI from functioning reliably
Unstructured returns-reason data means Agent 2 recommendations for returns AI cannot be validated against real patterns

risk_register.label: Regulatory compliance risk
risk_register.trigger_reason: governance_compliance final_score=4.76 vs thresholds HIGH<4.0 MEDIUM<6.0
risk_register.mitigation: Aspiga should conduct a thorough review of its governance and compliance policies to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements, particularly in light of its Klaviyo marketing automation tool integration with Shopify.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK GDPR 2018 — consent, data minimisation, subject access rights
fashion_extensions_applied: Personalisation profiling requires explicit consent — not implied by purchase history alone under UK GDPR
Automated pricing decisions may require human review disclosure under the UK AI Bill 2026

risk_register.label: Staff adoption risk
risk_register.trigger_reason: staff_digital_literacy final_score=7.47 vs thresholds HIGH<4.0 MEDIUM<6.0
risk_register.mitigation: Aspiga should provide regular digital literacy training sessions for staff to enhance their understanding of the Shopify platform and its features.
fashion_extensions_applied: Longer-serving retail staff may resist AI-assisted product recommendations if they perceive it as undermining their styling expertise
Owner-manager resistance is the single strongest predictor of failed AI adoption in fashion SMEs

risk_register.label: Vendor dependency risk
risk_register.mitigation: Aspiga should negotiate a service-level agreement with Klaviyo to ensure timely support and minimize potential disruptions to its Shopify operations.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 — data portability provisions
fashion_extensions_applied: Shopify platform dependency — significant portions of Agent 2 recommendations assume Shopify, creating risk if the business migrates platforms
Single marketing automation vendor lock-in — if Klaviyo is the only tool, all customer communication is at risk from a single vendor decision

risk_register.label: AI accuracy and hallucination risk
risk_register.mitigation: Aspiga should implement AI model monitoring and logging on the Shopify platform to detect and prevent potential hallucinations caused by its marketing automation tools.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK AI Bill 2026 — accuracy and transparency obligations
fashion_extensions_applied: AI-generated size advice that is wrong drives returns rather than reducing them — directly counterproductive to the primary use case
AI-generated product descriptions containing incorrect material composition create trading standards liability

risk_register.label: Ethical and bias risk
risk_register.mitigation: Aspiga should review and update its privacy policy to ensure transparency around its AI usage and data collection practices, particularly given its integration with Klaviyo and Google Analytics 4.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK Equality Act 2010 — protected characteristics in automated decision-making
fashion_extensions_applied: Sizing bias — AI sizing recommendations trained primarily on standard UK size data may underserve plus-size, petite or non-standard body types who represent a majority of real customers
Fast-fashion sustainability — AI demand forecasting optimised purely for sell-through rate may conflict with the business's sustainability commitments or consumer expectations around overconsumption

next_steps: Step 1: Set up the Trustpilot review collection email sequence to send to customers after purchase, using Aspiga's existing email marketing platform.
Step 2: Configure Trustpilot's review display settings to showcase reviews on Aspiga's product pages and improve online visibility.
Step 3: Monitor and respond to customer reviews on Trustpilot to demonstrate Aspiga's commitment to sustainability and customer satisfaction.

market_tools_recommended.why_this_business: Aspiga can leverage Trustpilot's independent review platform to improve credibility and trust with UK shoppers, who are familiar with the brand.
Judge.me's automated review collection feature can help Aspiga gather more reviews from customers, improving sustainability credibility and online visibility.
Yotpo's full-featured reviews and loyalty platform may be overkill for Aspiga's needs, given its moderate budget and focus on sustainability credibility.

roi_summary: Aspiga can expect to see significant commercial improvements across customer experience, returns management, and marketing efficiency. Automated Review Collection and Returns Reason Capture will be implemented in the first week, generating an immediate increase in reviews and returns data. The Size Guide Chatbot will be implemented in week 4, reducing size-related returns by up to 25%. Email Marketing Automation Flows will be implemented in week 6, increasing email marketing returns. The WhatsApp Styling Assistant will be implemented in week 8, enhancing customer engagement. Finally, AI Demand Forecasting will be implemented in week 12, optimizing inventory and reducing lost sales.

marketplace_summary.aiyyary_bridge_note: These agents are recommended as immediate solutions. As AIYYARY grows, custom-built equivalents will replace third-party dependencies where appropriate.
